notes: The source agrees with the served counts: Omega-3 166/7740 and Placebo Omega-3 135/7740. Counts are participants with fatal or non-fatal events. Each comparison group pools two factorial arms: Omega-3+Aspirin and Omega-3+Placebo Aspirin; Placebo Omega-3+Aspirin and Placebo Omega-3+Placebo Aspirin. The measure states 3870 participants in each component arm but does not give separate component event counts. No single registry arm ID represents either pooled group. Denominators are stated as Participants without explicit analysis-set qualification in this measure. Population eligibility and arm percentages are NOT_IN_PACKET within the required outcome measure. All spans are from this measure only.
